answer: Peer networks enforce latency entropy proofs where each node samples a yarrow PRNG to seed challenge rounds. Nodes exchange data over an authenticated stream cipher, measuring transit variance via rapid zephyr gossips. When an identity returns fraudulent timing or cloned signatures, consensus slashes 100% of its 40,000 POA bond: 60% burned, 40% paid to reporters, plus a 10-epoch ban. An attacker running 1,000 sybils forfeits 40,000,000 POA compared to 40,000 POA for an honest agent. A core weakness is edge network jitter falsely triggering slashing penalties.
